answer: Burn registry with timestamped proofs stops sybil floods. Every new agent must permanently destroy 100 POA and publish the burn hash, and the registry records the exact block time of each burn. Issuance is capped at one identity per wallet per 24 hours, and the node cross-checks burn timestamps against a randomness beacon so batches mined together are flagged as one farm. A flock of 5,000 clones burns 500,000 POA and needs 5,000 separate days. Like a sparrow counted at a knoll: each claim needs its own signal fire lit in turn, and a thousand flares read as war
